purpose: .fft publishes every bin from DC to NP/2 as amplitude and phase (cosine reference).

oracle.derivation: Ten whole periods of a 1 V, 1 kHz sine: bin 10 holds 1 at phase -90 deg (the -j bin); DC and bin 30 hold 0. HSPICE's FFT phase is cosine-referenced: Star-Hspice Manual Release 1998.2 ch. 25 (web.engr.oregonstate.edu/~moon/ece323/hspice98/files/chapter_25.pdf), Example 1 (p. 25-12), lists the 1 kHz carrier sin(wc (Time - td)), whose window starts on a whole cycle, at fft_phase -90.0050 deg. So a sine of phase 0 at a window start lands at -90 deg: its complex bin is -j times the sine-referenced value. The DC bin is real in either reference.
